title: Hailstorm
description: At the end of your turn, if you have [gold]Frost[/gold], deal 6 damage to ALL enemies.
upgraded_description: At the end of your turn, if you have [gold]Frost[/gold], deal 8 damage to ALL enemies.
notes: Hailstorm is a conditional power that triggers at the end of your turn. It deals damage to all enemies only if you have at least 1 Frost orb in your Orb queue. The damage amount is increased by the power stack.
